query:
UPDATE seller_profile_documents
         SET status = 'UPLOADED'::seller_profile_document_status
         WHERE profile_id = $1
           AND id = $2
           AND status NOT IN (
               'CLASSIFIED'::seller_profile_document_status,
               'EXTRACTED'::seller_profile_document_status,
               'FAILED'::seller_profile_document_status
           )
         RETURNING id AS "id!: Uuid"
